env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos test -count=1 -v ./...
stdout '^--- PASS: TestDouble '
stdout '^--- PASS: TestParse '
stdout '^--- PASS: TestFindExternal '
stdout '^--- PASS: TestOnlyTests '
logos eject -o out
exists out/x.go
exists out/x_test.go
exists out/ext_test.go
exists out/sub/s_test.go
! exists out/x_test.lgo
! exists out/ext_test.lgo
! exists out/sub/s_test.lgo
cd out
go test -count=1 -v ./...
stdout '^--- PASS: TestDouble '
stdout '^--- PASS: TestParse '
stdout '^--- PASS: TestFindExternal '
stdout '^--- PASS: TestOnlyTests '
! stdout '^--- FAIL'
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go test -count=1 -v ./...
stdout '^--- PASS: TestDouble '
stdout '^--- PASS: TestParse '
stdout '^--- PASS: TestFindExternal '
stdout '^--- PASS: TestOnlyTests '
! stdout '^--- FAIL'
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

cd bad
! logos test -count=1 -v ./...
stdout '^--- FAIL: TestBroken '
logos eject -o out
cd out
! go test -count=1 -v ./...
stdout '^--- FAIL: TestBroken '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
! exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go test -count=1 -v ./...
stdout '^--- FAIL: TestBroken '
cd ../..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejecttests

go 1.27

-- m/x.lgo --
package ejt

import "strconv"

func double(n int) int { return n * 2 }

func Parse(s string) (int, error) {
	n := strconv.Atoi(s)?
	return double(n), nil
}

func Find(xs []int, v int) int? {
	for _, x := range xs {
		if x == v {
			return x
		}
	}
	return nil
}

-- m/x_test.lgo --
package ejt

import "testing"

func TestDouble(t *testing.T) {
	if double(21) != 42 {
		t.Errorf("double(21) = %d", double(21))
	}
}

func TestParse(t *testing.T) {
	n, err := Parse("21")
	if err != nil {
		t.Errorf("Parse: %v", err)
		return
	}
	if n != 42 {
		t.Errorf("Parse = %d", n)
	}
	_, err = Parse("zz")
	if err == nil {
		t.Error("want an error")
	}
}

-- m/ext_test.lgo --
package ejt_test

import (
	"testing"

	"example.com/ejecttests"
)

func TestFindExternal(t *testing.T) {
	if got := ejt.Find([]int{1, 2, 3}, 2) ?? -1; got != 2 {
		t.Errorf("found %d", got)
	}
	if got := ejt.Find([]int{1, 2, 3}, 9) ?? -1; got != -1 {
		t.Errorf("found %d", got)
	}
}

-- m/sub/s_test.lgo --
package sub

import "testing"

func TestOnlyTests(t *testing.T) {
	var o int? = 5
	if (o ?? 0) != 5 {
		t.Error("option lost")
	}
}

-- bad/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectbad

go 1.27

-- bad/b.lgo --
package bad

func One() int { return 1 }

-- bad/b_test.lgo --
package bad

import "testing"

func TestBroken(t *testing.T) {
	if One() != 2 {
		t.Errorf("One() = %d", One())
	}
}
